street_smart.title: Your phone rings and a stranger says your daughter has been kidnapped. In the background a girl is crying, and he demands ₹5 lakh on UPI within 20 minutes or he will 'finish it'. He tells you not to hang up or call anyone. What do you do?
street_smart.based_on: Deccan Herald/New Indian Express Oct 2-3: Bengaluru man stages own kidnap, demands Rs 90 lakh from father.
street_smart.situation: You are alone at home, your heart is racing, and the caller keeps the line open and the pressure on.

choices.text: Transfer the money immediately so nothing happens to her.
choices.feedback: Scammers rely on panic and a short deadline so you cannot verify. The crying voice can be a recording or AI-cloned, and UPI payments are very hard to reverse.

choices.text: Stay on the line, negotiate the amount down, and pay part now.
choices.feedback: Staying on the line keeps you isolated, and paying part still loses money and tells them you will pay.

choices.text: Ask the caller to put her on to speak, then pay if she answers.
choices.feedback: A short scripted or cloned voice can pass this test. It is still better to verify through a separate channel.

choices.text: Hang up or put the call on hold, call your daughter and others who are with her on another phone, and dial 112 and 1930 if you cannot reach her.
choices.feedback: Breaking the isolation defeats the script. Most 'kidnappings' end the moment you reach the person, and the police can act fast if it is real.

takeaways: Verify directly: call the person from another phone before paying anything.
Call 112 for an emergency and 1930 or cybercrime.gov.in to report cyber fraud.
Agree a family code word you can ask for in a real emergency.

quiz.question: How much did the Bengaluru man demand from his father after staging his own kidnapping?
quiz.why: He reportedly did it to clear a debt. Police say to always verify a ransom call before paying.

quiz.question: Which two cities will the new Vande Bharat Sleeper connect?
quiz.why: It is reported to run six days a week. Sleeper versions are designed for overnight journeys.

quiz.question: How many barrels of oil have the G7 nations agreed to release?
quiz.why: Coordinated releases from strategic reserves are used to calm oil prices. India also maintains strategic petroleum reserves.

quiz.question: Under which Article of the Constitution is the Election Commission of India established?
quiz.why: Article 324 gives the EC superintendence of elections. The Chief Election Commissioner can be removed only like a Supreme Court judge.

quiz.question: What is the name of the rate at which the RBI lends short-term funds to commercial banks?
quiz.why: A higher repo rate generally makes loans costlier. The reverse repo rate is what the RBI pays banks for parking funds.
